## `neuro.float32Array.keys`

Instance method on `Float32Array.prototype`.

> Returns an list of keys in the array

## Signatures

```ts
keys(input: { float32Array: <receiver>; prompt?: string }): Promise<ArrayIterator<number>>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Float32Array.prototype.keys` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
